text: Takes way to long to boil.. Takes way to long to boil the water compared to another one I have.  Would never buy again.

product_metadata.title: Brentwood 1.2 Liter Stainless Steel Tea Kettle Model KT-1770
features: Auto shutoff when boiling or Dry
description: Heat water faster and more efficiently than a microwave with this 1.2 liter electric tea kettle finished in brushed stainless steel for a classic look. Featuring an illuminated power indicator and boil dry protection for safety. This electric tea kettle is ideal for a quick cup of tea or coffee with it's handy lift-off kettle allows for cord-free use and it's small enough to fit on a kitchen countertop without taking up very much space.
